AWPTCM-T43851.objective:
• Lease probing for a DHCP pool is enabled by default.
  • Probing can be enabled or disabled per DHCP pool using the "probe enable" and "no probe enable" commands.
  • When probing is enabled with type ARP, the DHCP server probes IP addresses using ARP packets before assigning leases.
  • The number of probe packets and timeout are configurable (default 5 packets, timeout range).
  • Show commands display the probing configuration and status for pools.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability.
Configure a DHCP pool and verify that probing is enabled by default (using ARP). Use "show ip dhcp pool" to confirm.
Disable probing with "no probe enable" on the pool and verify it is disabled. Re-enable and confirm.
Set probe type to ARP, configure number of packets (e.g. 3), and verify with capture or behavior that ARP probes are sent the configured number of times.
Test with a client and verify probing prevents assignment of in-use IPs.
